dummy_payments_amounts.name: dummy_payments_amounts
dummy_payments_amounts.value: "dummy_payments"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "dummy_payments"."subtotal" BETWEEN 0 AND 214748364700 AND "dummy_payments"."discount" BETWEEN 0 AND "dummy_payments"."subtotal" AND "dummy_payments"."total" = "dummy_payments"."subtotal" - "dummy_payments"."discount"

dummy_payments_simulation.name: dummy_payments_simulation
dummy_payments_simulation.value: "dummy_payments"."is_dummy" = true AND "dummy_payments"."method" = 'dummy_qr' AND "dummy_payments"."qr_payload" = 'DUMMY:' || "dummy_payments"."id"::text AND (("dummy_payments"."status" = 'paid' AND "dummy_payments"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("dummy_payments"."status" != 'paid' AND "dummy_payments"."paid_at" IS NULL))

promos_validity.name: promos_validity
promos_validity.value: "promos"."starts_at" < "promos"."ends_at" AND "promos"."value" >= 1 AND ("promos"."discount_type" != 'percentage' OR "promos"."value" <= 100) AND "promos"."min_amount" >= 0 AND ("promos"."max_discount" IS NULL OR "promos"."max_discount" >= 0) AND "promos"."code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,32}$'
